title: Experiment numbering reads numeric suffixes from ancestor directories
reasoning: The suffix regex searches the entire child path, so a matching ancestor takes precedence over the child's experiment number. Under /runs/exp_001, existing children exp_001 and exp_002 both produce ID 1. The function consequently selects exp_002 again, and exist_ok=True silently reuses it instead of creating a new experiment directory.
reproduction: Use an experiment_dir ending in exp_001 with children exp_001 and exp_002, then call get_next_experiment_dir. It returns the existing exp_002 directory.
recommendation: Match an escaped prefix and numeric suffix against each child's name only, using a full match, and reject an already-existing destination.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied evaluation utils test covers a different module's dictionary merge; no included test exercises experiment-directory numbering.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover numbering under ancestors containing experiment-like names and with varied literal prefixes, asserting every successful allocation creates a previously absent directory.
minimumFixScope: get_next_experiment_dir suffix parsing and directory-allocation tests.
